name: Cloud and AI
description: Cloud platform and applied AI topics, with contested ground around data, autonomy and headcount.

cards.tooltip: The split between what your cloud provider secures and what you still own.
cards.tooltipMeme: The contract everyone cites after the incident and nobody reads before it.

cards.tooltip: One trusted identity provider issuing access across many cloud services.
cards.tooltipMeme: One login to rule them all. Hope it has MFA.

cards.tooltip: Defining cloud resources in version-controlled templates instead of clicking through a portal.
cards.tooltipMeme: Your outage is now reproducible across three regions simultaneously.

cards.tooltip: Automated scheduling, scaling and healing of containerized workloads.
cards.tooltipMeme: You wanted to ship an app. Now you operate a small distributed operating system.

cards.tooltip: Legal and contractual limits on which geography your data is allowed to live in.
Measuring an AI model's accuracy, bias and failure modes before trusting it with real work.
cards.tooltipMeme: The step between the demo was amazing and why on earth did it do that.

cards.tooltip: Untrusted input hijacking an AI system's instructions to change what it does.
Grounding a model's answers in your own documents rather than its training data.
cards.tooltipMeme: Teaching the model to cite sources so it can be wrong with footnotes.

cards.tooltip: Controlling spend through budgets, tagging and rightsizing before the invoice arrives.
cards.tooltipMeme: The forgotten GPU cluster now has its own line item and arguably its own headcount.

cards.tooltip: Running code without provisioning or managing the servers underneath it.
cards.tooltipMeme: There are still servers. You are simply not invited to meet them.

cards.tooltip: Should providers train their models on the data you store with them?
cards.tooltipMeme: Your private documents turned out to be a very promising student.

cards.tooltip: How much machine-written code belongs in critical systems without a human reading it?
Should AI agents be allowed to take real actions in live systems without a human approving each one?
cards.tooltipMeme: Handing production credentials to something that confidently makes things up.

cards.tooltip: Where is the line between augmenting a security team and quietly shrinking it?
cards.tooltipMeme: The SOC is now one very tired person and a subscription.

cards.tooltip: How much strategic freedom is worth trading away for one provider's convenience?
cards.tooltipMeme: The exit plan is a slide nobody has ever costed.
